title: Cart total shows $0.30000000000000004 in the UI
body: Add three 10-cent items to the cart and the total renders as $0.30000000000000004 instead of $0.30. The total should be exact to the cent — do the math in integer cents internally and return dollars rounded to 2 decimals (a number like 0.3, not a string).
bug: cartTotal accumulates floating-point dollars, producing classic 0.1+0.2 rounding artifacts.
